loginSubtitle: Operations dashboard for provider approvals and marketplace oversight.
mfaSetupLead: Scan this QR with Google Authenticator, Authy, or similar. Then enter the 6-digit code to finish registration.
mfaVerifyLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfaResetLoginHint: Forgot your authenticator, or the code keeps failing? Reset MFA, then scan a new QR.
mfaResetLoginLead: Enter your admin password. We will show a new QR code. Old authenticator codes will stop working.
geoStatesLead: Browse providers and job stats by Indian state, then drill into districts.
geoDistrictsLead: Districts in this state with provider counts and job outcomes.
geoProvidersLead: Providers assigned to this district. Create a new provider here or assign an existing one.
geoAddProviderLead: New provider will be placed in {{district}}, {{state}}.
geoNoProvidersToAssign: No other providers available to assign. Create a new one instead.
geoBlockRequired: Select a block. This district has more than one block.
actAsSuperAdminLead: Enter the 4-digit Super Admin key to add or remove admin accounts.
updateSuperAdminKeyLead: Only someone with the current key can change it.
superAdminRequired: Act as Super Admin first to manage admin accounts.
superAdminRequiredPinPassword: Act as Super Admin to reset an admin's MFA or password.
backupLead: Download a copy of Akanso data from this server, and keep the file somewhere safe. Only Super Admin can do this. Photos on S3 are not inside this file.
backupDownloadLead: This file is enough to recreate Users, Partners, jobs, geography, and other collections in a new MongoDB.
backupDownloadHint: Store the JSON file offline. Download again after important changes.
backupCollectionsHint: Tick collections to download or update only those. Unticked collections are left alone on restore.
backupRestoreSelectedHint: Checked collections below will be replaced from the file. Unchecked collections stay as they are.
backupUpdateConfirmLead: Only these collections will be emptied and filled from the file: {{names}}. Type RESTORE to continue.
backupActivityLead: Every Super Admin download and restore is listed here.
backupDownloadStartedDetail: Keep this file private. It includes account data needed to restore Akanso.
backupRestoreLead: Use this only if this database is empty or you intend to replace the collections in the file. Type RESTORE to confirm.
backupFileRequired: Choose a backup JSON file first.
backupRestoreConfirmLead: Collections named in the file will be emptied, then filled from the backup. Other collections stay as they are. Type RESTORE to continue.
creativesLead: Upload one image, many images, or a whole folder. They are stored on S3 and you can download them anytime to share.
creativesDropHint: Or drop files or a folder here. JPEG, PNG, WebP only.
creativesNoImages: No JPEG, PNG, or WebP files in that selection.
creativesUploadCapped: Only the first {{max}} images were taken from this folder.
creativesEmpty: No images yet. Upload files or a folder of JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
creativesCopyFailed: Could not copy the link. Use Download instead.
creativesUploadedDetail: You can download it from this page whenever you need it.
creativesUploadedDetailCount: {{count}} image(s) saved. You can download them from this page whenever you need them.
creativesDeleteLead: This deletes the file from S3. You will not be able to download it from here afterwards.
pinRevealFailed: PIN could not be revealed. Reset the PIN to create a recoverable one.
feedbackLead: Suggestions submitted from Partner and Customer apps.
permissionsLead: Choose how partners show up, get verified, take open work, and chat on jobs.
clientsLead: Manage white-label clients, product names, logo, and themeColors. The active client’s branding is what Customer and Provider apps receive.
clientsLogoUrlPlaceholder: https://… or upload below after save
clientsLogoHint: Save the client first, then upload a logo image (PNG/JPG/WebP).
logoInvalidType: Logo must be PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP.
logoTooLarge: Logo must be smaller than 5 MB.
clientsThemeLead: Use a coherent shared palette for Customer, Partner, and Admin experiences.
clientsThemePresetConfirmLead: Your current custom colors will be replaced.
clientsThemeColorInvalid: {{field}} must be a valid 6-digit hex color.
overviewLead: Marketplace health at a glance — pies for status mix, bars for geography and services. Pick a state to drill into districts.
overviewDetailHint: Live snapshot from the latest load. Click a stat card to focus this panel.
overviewProvidersLead: {{count}} providers on the platform by approval status.
overviewUsersMixLead: Unique people versus Customer and Partner memberships. Dual-role users count once in Unique users.
overviewProvidersPieLead: Pending, approved, and rejected providers — status you can read in one glance.
overviewJobsPieLead: How work is flowing: pending through completed and cancelled.
overviewStateBarLead: Providers, customers, and jobs compared across states.
overviewDistrictBarLead: Providers, customers, and jobs by district for the selected state.
overviewServiceBarLead: Which services have the most providers and job demand.
overviewChartEmpty: No location-tagged data yet for this view.
overviewTrendLead: Track how customers, providers, job cards, and total reach grow over time.
overviewTrendEmpty: No dated growth data in this window yet.
approvalsLead: Review pending providers and approve or reject with a reason.
addCustomerLead: Create a customer account for the customer app. Enter the 10-digit mobile number (+91 is assumed).
editCustomerLead: Update name and service address for this customer.
customerSavedDetail: Customer profile and address were updated.
addProviderLead: Create a provider with name, phone, address, and a service from your categories. Experience and rating are optional.
bulkPartnersLead: Paste from Excel, review rows, then insert one at a time.
bulkPartnersPastePlaceholder: Copy rows from Excel (Phone, Name, Service, Address, Experience, Gender, State, District, Block, City, Pincode, Rating) and paste here.
bulkPartnersPasteEmpty: No rows found. Paste data from Excel first.
bulkPartnersGenderNote: Gender is shown for your reference only and is not saved yet.
bulkPartnersEmptyTable: No draft rows yet. Paste from Excel and click Load rows.
bulkPartnersServiceUnknown: Unknown service — check spelling or category list.
bulkPartnersExperienceInvalid: Experience must be a valid number.
bulkPartnersStepLocationLead: Used when a row has no State, District, Block, City, or Pincode in Excel.
bulkPartnersStepPasteLead: Download the Excel template (Service, State, and District dropdowns), fill rows, copy them, paste below, then Load rows.
bulkPartnersStepReviewLead: Fix service (dropdown) and any other field, then insert one at a time. Partner PIN is the first 6 digits of the mobile number.
bulkPartnersEmptyHint: Download the template or paste from Excel above, then click Load rows.
phoneTenDigits: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
partnerServicesLead: One Partner account can offer multiple services. Account approval stays separate from service verification.
partnerServicesAvailabilityLead: After a service is verified, turn availability on so customers can find this Partner for that service.
partnerServicesEmpty: No services on this Partner yet.
manageServiceLead: Update the service-specific profile for {{service}}. This does not change the Partner account or other services.
serviceInformationPlaceholder: Describe the work experience, skills, and scope...
serviceAvailabilityVerifyFirst: Verify this service before turning availability on.
serviceActivatedDetail: {{service}} is now active and visible to customers.
serviceDeactivatedDetail: {{service}} is now inactive and hidden from customer browse.
deactivateLead: Deactivate {{name}}? They will not be able to sign in until restored.
deactivationReasonRequired: A reason is required to deactivate.
resetCustomerPinLead: Set a new Customer PIN. The Partner PIN will not change.
resetPartnerPinLead: Set a new Partner PIN. The Customer PIN will not change.
deactivateCustomerLead: Deactivate Customer access for {{name}}? Partner access is not changed.
deactivatePartnerLead: Deactivate Partner access for {{name}}? Customer access is not changed.
partnerAccessDeactivatedDetail: {{name}} can no longer sign in as a Partner.
partnerAccessRestoredDetail: {{name}} can sign in as a Partner again.
customerJobFeedbackLead: Comments left by customers on job cards assigned to this provider.
noCustomerFeedback: No customer comments on assigned jobs yet.
pinMustBeSix: PIN must be exactly 6 digits, or leave blank to auto-generate.
adminsLead: Invite admins with a shareable activation link (no email). They set a password and Google Authenticator before signing in.
addAdminLead: Enter name, email, and permissions. An activation link is returned for you to share via WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, or SMS. No email is sent.
permissionsInviteHint: All modules are selected by default. Uncheck any the admin should not access.
permissionsModulesHint: Toggle modules to grant or revoke all related capabilities.
editPermissionsLead: Update capabilities for {{name}}. Changes apply on their next login.
permissionsUpdatedDetail: {{name}} will receive the new permissions on next sign-in.
adminCreatedLead: Send this link to the new admin. They must open it once to set a password. It expires in 24 hours.
activationLinkCopiedDetail: Paste it into WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, or SMS.
invitationCancelledDetail: The activation link no longer works.
resetMfaLead: Clear MFA for {{name}}? On their next login they must scan a new QR and enroll again.
mfaResetDetail: {{name}} must set up authenticator again on next sign-in.
jobsLead: Open a job to view details, assign or change providers, update status, and add comments.
exportSuperAdminOnly: Elevate to Super Admin to export job cards.
assignProviderLead: Pick an approved provider for this job. Confirming sets status to accepted and notifies the customer when push is available.
changeProviderLead: Select a different approved provider, or unassign to leave the job pending.
searchPartnersPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or location...
changePartnerConfirmLead: This will reassign the job to the selected Partner.
assignPartnerConfirmLead: This will assign the job to the selected Partner.
activeJobReassignWarning: This will change the assigned Partner on an active job.
noEligiblePartnersFound: No matching Partners found for this service and area.
jobUnassignedStatusHint: Assign a Partner first. Status will follow the existing assignment flow.
unassignConfirm: Remove the provider from this job? Status will become unassigned.
categoriesLead: Manage categories, bilingual copy, and booking questionnaires.
categorySectionsLead: Manage All Services grouping titles (English / Hindi). Categories pick a section key.
sectionLabelsRequired: English and Hindi labels are required.
categoryEditLead: Edit category details and the questions customers answer when booking.
categoryDiscoveryLead: Controls how this category appears in CustomerWeb search and the All Services sections. Popular Services still uses the Popular checkbox above.
categorySearchTermsHint: Comma or new-line separated. Customers can find this service using any of these terms.
contactsLead: Review provider contacts shared by customers and providers.
updateContactLead: Edit the recommended provider details, location, service, and status.
commentPlaceholder: Write an admin note for this job…
cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role.
cannotDeleteOwnAccount: You cannot delete your own account.
addUserLead: Create a customer, provider, or admin account. Phone is stored as +91 and 10-digit local.
deleteUserLead: This permanently removes {{name}}. This cannot be undone.
setPasswordLead: Stored passwords are encrypted and cannot be viewed. Enter a new password for this user.
setPinLead: Enter a 6-digit PIN or leave blank to auto-generate a unique PIN.
pinUpdatedDetail: {{name}} can now sign in with phone {{phone}}. Share the PIN securely — it is shown below briefly.
pinUpdatedDetailNoPhone: {{name}} can now sign in with the PIN shown below. Share it securely.
passwordUpdatedDetail: A new password was set for {{name}}. For security, passwords cannot be viewed again after saving.
pinNotRecoverable: Set before Firebase removal — reset to view
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
name: Name
contactPrivacyLead: Control whether customers can see a provider's phone number. The backend enforces this policy on every customer-facing response.
contactPrivacyOption_ACCEPTED_ONLY: Show number after request is accepted
contactPrivacyOption_ACTIVE_REQUEST_ONLY: Show number only during active request
contactPrivacyHelp_DIRECT: Customers see the real phone number on browse and request screens.
contactPrivacyHelp_MASKED: The real number is never returned to customers.
contactPrivacyHelp_ACCEPTED_ONLY: The number is returned only after the provider accepts.
contactPrivacyHelp_ACTIVE_REQUEST_ONLY: The number is returned only while the request is pending, accepted, or in progress.
contactPrivacyConfirmBody: You are changing how provider phone numbers are shown to customers. Continue?
contactPrivacySavedDetail: Customers will now see provider phone numbers according to the selected policy.
contactPrivacyNoPermission: You can view this setting but you do not have permission to change it.
partnerVerificationLead: Choose whether Partners go live automatically when their profile is complete, or only after Admin approval.
partnerVerificationHelp_AUTO: When name, profession, address, experience, and phone are complete, the Partner is verified and shown to customers immediately.
partnerVerificationHelp_ADMIN: Partners submit details and wait for Admin to verify each service. Documents may be required on service submit.
partnerVerificationConfirmBody: This affects how new and updated Partner profiles go live. Existing approved Partners are not changed. Continue?
partnerVerificationSavedDetail: New profile submissions will follow the selected policy.
partnerVerificationNoPermission: You can view this setting but you do not have permission to change it.
providerOpenRequestsLead: Control whether approved Partners must be online to receive and accept new open customer requests. Turn on when partner density is low.
providerOpenRequestsHelp_OFF: Open requests reach only Partners who toggled Online. Best when you have enough active Partners in each area.
providerOpenRequestsHelp_ON: Approved Partners in the area receive open requests even while Offline. They can accept without going Online first. Use for early launch or sparse areas.
providerOpenRequestsConfirmBodyOn: Offline Partners will start receiving open customer requests and can accept them without going Online. Continue?
providerOpenRequestsConfirmBodyOff: Only Online Partners will receive new open requests. Offline Partners must go Online to accept. Continue?
providerOpenRequestsSavedDetailOn: Offline Partners can now receive and accept open requests.
providerOpenRequestsSavedDetailOff: Open requests now require Partners to be Online.
providerOpenRequestsNoPermission: You can view this setting but you do not have permission to change it.
jobCommentsLead: Control whether Customers and Partners can chat on accepted service requests. Turn off to hide chat and block new messages.
jobCommentsHelp_ON: After a request is accepted, Customer and Partner can message each other on the job. Existing messages stay visible while chat is on.
jobCommentsHelp_OFF: Chat is hidden in Customer and Partner apps. New messages are blocked. Use when you want support only through admin or phone.
jobCommentsConfirmBodyOn: Customers and Partners will be able to chat on accepted requests. Continue?
jobCommentsConfirmBodyOff: Job chat will be hidden and new messages will be blocked for Customers and Partners. Continue?
jobCommentsSavedDetailOn: Job chat is now enabled for Customers and Partners.
jobCommentsSavedDetailOff: Job chat is now disabled for Customers and Partners.
jobCommentsNoPermission: You can view this setting but you do not have permission to change it.
greetingLead: Turn on a festival wish for a special day. The Customer app loads as usual. After sign-in, people see the greeting once, then Continue into the app.
greetingDoodleLead: A Material icon or image beside the Akanso logo for a set time. Everyone sees it until Show doodle until.
greetingDoodleEnabledHelp: Shown next to the product logo in CustomerWeb.
greetingDoodleEnabledHelp_on: Icon or image stays beside the logo until Show doodle until.
greetingDoodleTimerHelp: After this time the doodle hides for everyone. Customers never see the time.
greetingDoodleTimerRequired: Set Show doodle until when the doodle is on.
greetingStateHelp_LAUNCH: After sign-in, customers see the greeting until they tap Continue or Show until ends.
greetingStateHelp_NORMAL: CustomerWeb shows the regular Akanso experience.
greetingCloseModeHelp: For a special day, keep Each person once so everyone who opens the app that day can see the greeting.
greetingCloseModeHelp_PER_PERSON: Continue hides the greeting only for that person. Others still see it until they continue or the timer ends.
greetingCloseModeHelp_GLOBAL: The first person who taps Continue hides the greeting for every visitor. Avoid this for a festival day.
greetingMessagePlaceholder: One sentence under the greeting. Leave empty if the greeting is enough.
greetingGreetingHelp: This is the only headline customers see, with their first name or Akanso Family. Example: Happy Holi, Akanksha.
greetingTimerHelp: After this time the greeting hides for everyone. Customers never see the time.
greetingTimerRequired: Set Show until when the greeting page is on. That is the end of the special day.
greetingAnimationHelp: Auto uses diyas for Diwali and sparkle otherwise. Or pick firecrackers, diyas, sparkle, or none.
greetingVisitorHelp: Signed-in visitors see their first name. Guests see Akanso Family. The button is always Continue.
greetingLogoAccentHelp: Optional. If set, this image is shown beside the logo instead of the Material icon. Host a PNG/WebP on assets.akanso.in (or another https URL).
greetingIconHelp: Material Symbols name shown beside the Akanso logo when no image URL is set. Pick one below or type any icon name from fonts.google.com/icons.
greetingIconCustom: Or type a Material icon name
greetingConfirmBody: This changes what Customer visitors see until they tap Continue, the timer ends, or you switch back to normal.
greetingConfirmLaunchNote: Signed-in customers see the greeting overlay before Show until. Continue is per person unless you chose Anyone closes it for all.
greetingConfirmNormalNote: Customer visitors will see the normal website immediately.
greetingSavedDetailLaunch: CustomerWeb is now showing the greeting page.
greetingSavedDetailNormal: CustomerWeb is now showing the normal website.
greetingDoodleConfirmBody: This only changes the icon or image beside the Customer logo.
greetingDoodleConfirmOnNote: The doodle will show until the time you set.
greetingDoodleSavedDetailOn: The doodle is on until Show doodle until.
